mission: Haize Labs started as an automated red-teaming company ('haizing': stress-testing AI to find failures before deployment). It now builds expert-level agents for mission-critical work using its 'Reliability Harness': supervisor models, simulation testing, red-teaming and guardrails.

key_work.title: Haize Reliability Harness
key_work.plain_summary: Supervisor AIs that oversee other agents, exhaustive simulation tests, red-teaming and runtime guardrails for enterprise agents.

warnings.text: AI that is 'good enough' in a demo can fail unpredictably in production.
Rare edge cases and jailbreaks escape ordinary testing.

recommendations.text: Fuzz and red-team AI systems automatically before deployment.
Use supervisor models and guardrails to monitor agents at runtime.
